  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  July 26, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:31 am.

  Members Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Koike, Sharon, Finance Department
  Ybarra, Dominique, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of July 12, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. MGT of America Consulting LLC – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  services to the City in the amount of $5,336.15. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Dewey Pest Control – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing pest control
  services to the City in the amount of $5,200.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting
adjourned at 9:35 a.m. Adjournment
